messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "do not exceed 100 mg a day for children 2 to 12 years"
set: ["do not exceed 100 mg a day for children 2 to 12 years", "do not exceed 37.5 mg a day for infants and children under 2 years", "dose increases should not exceed 100 mg per day in a 3-day period", "do not exceed recommended dose", "do not use fluticasone furoate nasal spray for children under 2 years", "8 mg oral dose administered twice a day for patients 12 years and older", "increase to 100 mg orally once a day for type 2 diabetic nephropathy patients requiring titration", "usual starting dose for edema is 100 mg a day", "doses above 100 mg a day do not generally lower blood pressure any further", "do not exceed the maximum single dose of 150 mg for immediate-release tablets", "do not use fluticasone propionate nasal spray for children under 4 years", "continue until dosage reaches 100 mg a day", "avoid use in children younger than 12 years old", "8 mg taken orally 2 times a day", "extended-release (XR), ages 6 to 12 years", "increase to 100 mg orally three times a day after 3 days"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
